bestiary.title: Bestiary
bestiary.naiwa_chaser.attack: Follows you, crouches to wind up once it gets close and locks its direction the moment the wind-up starts, then lunges for a bite. It has to pause after each lunge. Touching it also hurts.
bestiary.naiwa_chaser.desc: Heavy forearms hold up a leaning body beneath a sleepy stare. Sidestep the crouch and strike during the pause after its lunge.
bestiary.naiwa_scout.attack: Sprints after you on long legs and rams into you.
bestiary.naiwa_scout.desc: A mint-colored body on long, reed-like folded hindlegs. Low HP but the fastest common enemy; avoid being surrounded.
bestiary.naiwa_spitter.attack: Keeps its distance and blows a single bubble shot from its tiny mouth whenever it can see you. It may puff its cheeks before firing, but can shoot immediately when already ready.
bestiary.naiwa_spitter.desc: Pink cheek pouches dwarf the tiny mouth of this lilac frog. Break line of sight behind a wall or pillar to stop its shots.
bestiary.naiwa_hopper.attack: Never walks, only jumps. It compresses its hindlegs, locks onto your position at take-off and crashes down there, sending a ring of bubbles out on landing. It can't hurt you by touch while airborne.
bestiary.naiwa_hopper.desc: A butter-yellow body rests between huge folded hindlegs. Move when it crouches so its slam misses.
bestiary.naiwa_gasser.attack: Chases you and drops a green gas cloud every so often. The gas lingers on the floor and keeps damaging you while you stand in it. Touching it also hurts.
bestiary.naiwa_gasser.desc: Three hollow reeds rise from its back above drooping pale cheeks. Avoid following it through the gas it leaves behind.
bestiary.naiwa_tank.attack: Plods after you and rams you with its body.
bestiary.naiwa_tank.desc: A cracked ceramic shell shelters its face above two massive paws. Tough but slow; back away while shooting.
bestiary.naiwa_turret.attack: Stays planted in place. When it can see you it spits a fan of seeds at you, sometimes lowering its crest first; it can fire immediately when ready.
bestiary.naiwa_turret.desc: A coral mushroom crest shades its face above three heavy petal feet. It stays put; take cover to avoid its shots.
bestiary.naiwa_charger.attack: Never walks over: it crouches in place to wind up, locks onto your direction when the wind-up starts, then it charges at you at high speed. It stops for a while after each charge.
bestiary.naiwa_charger.desc: A wedge-shaped head, short horn and swept-back fins form a living battering ram. Sidestep its charge and attack during recovery.
bestiary.naiwa_splitter.attack: Wobbles after you to ram you. When defeated it breaks apart into a swarm of tadpoles that keep chasing you.
bestiary.naiwa_splitter.desc: Dark tadpole shapes float inside a seafoam jelly belly. Clear nearby enemies first so its offspring cannot join a bigger crowd.
bestiary.naiwa_tongue.attack: Hovers at close range, aims, and lashes out a long tongue. It tracks you during the first part of the wind-up and locks its direction at the last moment. A hit hurts and pulls you toward it. The tongue can't pass through walls.
bestiary.naiwa_tongue.desc: A long pink tongue wraps around its shoulders like a scarf. Its lash travels in a straight line; sidestep the wind-up.
bestiary.naiwa_bomber.attack: Runs up to you, stops and swells with cream flashes. When its wind-up ends it explodes, hurting you if you're close and scattering a ring of shots. It destroys itself in the blast.
bestiary.naiwa_bomber.desc: A tiny face sits on a coral puffer belly with short fins. Contact alone does not hurt; run when it begins to swell.
bestiary.naiwa_brood.attack: Keeps away from you and every so often pulses to hatch a few tadpoles. Each Cradleback Frog can only keep a limited number of its own tadpoles alive at once, and hatches more as they die. Touching it also hurts.
bestiary.naiwa_brood.desc: A cream cradle holds pearl-like eggs on its back, guarded by broad hands. Deal with it early or more tadpoles will hatch.
bestiary.naiwa_burrower.attack: Burrows and tunnels toward a spot next to you; it can't be hit or touched while underground or surfacing. A mound marks its underground position. It fires a ring of shots as it emerges, stays above ground for a moment, then digs back down.
bestiary.naiwa_burrower.desc: A shovel snout and enormous ivory claws clear a path underground. Attack during its pause above the surface.
bestiary.naiwa_dancer.attack: Circles you sideways and switches direction without warning. Every so often it stops for a pirouette, firing rotating spirals of shots.
bestiary.naiwa_dancer.desc: A slender body balances on one foot as orange tail fans and webbed hands spin. Wait for a gap in its spiraling shots.
bestiary.naiwa_tadpole.attack: Darts after you and rams you.
bestiary.naiwa_tadpole.desc: A single large eye and a hooked tail mark these tiny offspring of Jellybrood Frogs, Cradleback Frogs and Naiguai. Very low HP and no loot.
bestiary.naiwa_boss.attack: Keeps its distance while firing volleys at you, and rotates through three moves. Belly Charge: tracks you while winding up, lights up pale chevrons, locks its direction and rushes; crashing into a pillar, an inner wall or a fallen rock stuns it for a while and it takes extra damage while stunned, but hitting the outer room wall only stops it. Belly Slam: locks onto your position at take-off, sends a big ring of shots out on landing, drops rocks near you and leaves a slowing milk puddle. Belly Laugh: spins in place firing rings of shots. Below about two thirds of its HP its volleys become rings, it moves faster and starts summoning tadpoles; below about one third the volleys get denser and faster, it charges twice in a row and calls down rock showers around you. Cream square corner brackets mark its slam landing point. Red corner brackets tighten around falling-rock landing points from the start. The rocks remain as obstacles for a while after landing.
bestiary.naiwa_boss.desc: The master of the Milk Temple, with a cream belly and a soft milk-drop crest. Immune to freeze. Bait a charge into a pillar or rock and attack while it is stunned.
